error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page couldn't be loaded. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address you opened doesn't exist.
notFound.gone: What you opened doesn't exist, or was deleted.

apiError.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
apiError.payload_too_large: The data you sent is too large.
apiError.not_ready: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
apiError.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
apiError.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact your Manager or the Owner.
apiError.rate_limited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
apiError.rate_limited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
apiError.token_invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
apiError.password_too_short: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
apiError.password_too_long: The password can have at most {{max}} characters.
apiError.password_same_as_username: The password can't be the same as the username.
apiError.invalid_request: The request is malformed. Reload the page, then try again.
apiError.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
apiError.refresh_superseded: The session was just renewed. Try again.
apiError.email_unchanged: That's already your account's email address.
apiError.password_change_required: Change your password before you continue.
apiError.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
apiError.outlet_not_found: This outlet doesn't exist, or you can't open it.
apiError.outlet_inactive: Your outlet is deactivated. Contact the Owner.
apiError.outlet_code_taken: Another outlet has this code. The code of a deleted outlet can't be used again either.
apiError.outlet_active: Deactivate this outlet before you delete it.
apiError.outlet_name_mismatch: The name you typed isn't the outlet's name.
apiError.role_name_taken: Another role of this outlet has this name.
apiError.role_in_use: This role is still in use. Move its users to another role first.
apiError.permission_not_held: This involves a permission you don't have yourself.
apiError.user_not_found: This user isn't in this outlet.
apiError.username_taken: This username is taken. The username of a deleted user can't be used again either.
apiError.own_account: You can't change your own account here.
apiError.owner_manages_managers: The Owner manages Manager accounts. Staff accounts are their outlet's Managers' job.
apiError.manager_account: Only the Owner creates and changes Manager accounts.
apiError.category_name_taken: Another category of this outlet has this name.
apiError.category_in_use: This category still holds {{menus}} menus. Move or delete them first.
apiError.categories_changed: The categories changed a moment ago. Their order has been reloaded; try again.
apiError.menu_sku_taken: Another menu of this outlet has this SKU.
apiError.voucher_not_found: There's no voucher with this code.
apiError.voucher_code_taken: Another voucher has this code. The code of a deleted voucher can be used again.
apiError.voucher_used: This voucher has been used, so it can't be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
apiError.voucher_used_up: This voucher has been used up.
apiError.voucher_not_for_outlet: This voucher isn't valid at this outlet.
apiError.voucher_min_spend: This order is below the voucher's minimum spend.
apiError.area_name_taken: Another area of this outlet has this name.
apiError.area_not_empty: This area still holds {{tables}} tables. Move or delete them first.
apiError.areas_changed: The areas changed a moment ago. Their order has been reloaded; try again.
apiError.layout_changed: This area's layout or tables changed since the editor was opened. Reload the layout, then arrange it again.
apiError.table_name_taken: Another table of this outlet has this name.
apiError.table_occupied: Customers are seated at this table. Release it first.
apiError.table_unavailable: This table can't be chosen now.
apiError.dine_in_mode_changed: How this outlet seats its dine-in customers just changed: at tables, or by number stands.
apiError.schedule_closed: This schedule is finished or cancelled, so it can't change any more.
apiError.schedule_overlaps: This schedule overlaps another at the same tables.

validation.format: This isn't in the right format.
validation.email: This isn't a valid email address.
validation.different: The closing time can't be the opening time.
validation.range: The number is out of range.
validation.insufficient: More than there is in stock.
validation.exists: This choice no longer exists. Reload the page, then choose again.
validation.locked: This voucher has been used, so this field can't change.
validation.decrease: This voucher has been used, so its uses can only grow.
validation.earlier: This voucher has been used, so its expiry can only move later.
validation.future: It must be later than now.
validation.after: It must be after the start.

noAccess.body: Your account can't open any page here yet. Contact your outlet's Manager.
